Senses.Explanation: A comic epithet for a one-sided person: a fellow carrying a board and seeing only one side. The stock line says that Xu Six carries a board and sees only one side, while Baiyu Jingsi states directly that each party sees one side and is precisely a board-carrying fellow (各見一邊，正是擔板漢). In a case Baiyu raises, Muezhou Daozong calls to an addressee and applies the name when the man turns; Xuedou Chongxian and Huanglong Huinan then debate its application, and Baiyu judges their opposed comments one-sided. The label extends beyond that case. Dongshan Meixi Du says that learning without awakening is overbearing pride, whereas awakening without learning is a board-carrying fellow (有學無悟謂之增上慢，有悟無學謂之擔板漢). Zhe'an Jingfan applies it both to delight at a rich feast and fear in a thorn thicket, and elsewhere says that enumerating ranks, mysteries, divisions, reality, and expedients only makes such a fellow before asking how the matter can be raised whole (只成擔板漢，此事如何舉得全). Yuanwu Keqin says that a board-carrying fellow often dies in the phrase (若是擔板漢，多向句中死却). Zen bends a comic physical image into a public epithet for the person whom a record presents as fixed on one side or trapped in wording; the entry reports those attested applications without generalizing beyond them.
Senses.Note: The headword occurs 193 times in 90 allowlisted texts; the shorter form for carrying a board (擔板) occurs 589 times in 186 texts. Six exact witnesses and one family witness cover the one-side formula, Muezhou case, paired formulas, and direct teaching-seat applications. These are local applications of one epithet, not separate referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 各見一邊，正是擔板漢。今晚或云：『雲門與麼道，也是擔板漢。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), Baiyu Jingsi says that the opposed commentators each see one side and are precisely a board-carrying fellow (擔板漢).

Occurrences.Kwic: 睦州和尚一日喚僧云：『大德！』僧回首，州云：『擔板漢。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), Baiyu Jingsi raises the case in which Muezhou Daozong calls to an addressee and names him a board-carrying fellow (擔板漢) when he turns.

Occurrences.Kwic: 有學無悟謂之增上慢，有悟無學謂之擔板漢。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Dongshan Meixi Du (東山梅溪度禪師語錄), Dongshan Meixi Du says that awakening without learning is called a board-carrying fellow (擔板漢).

Occurrences.Kwic: 坐豐美筵席，唱太平曲子，無不爽心稱快，也是擔板漢。住荊棘叢林，入虎狼群隊，無不戰驚受懼，也是擔板漢。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Zhe'an Fan (蔗菴範禪師語錄), Zhe'an Jingfan applies the label board-carrying fellow (擔板漢) both to delight at a rich feast and to fear amid thorns, tigers, and wolves.

Occurrences.Kwic: 只成擔板漢。此事如何舉得全？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Zhe'an Fan (蔗菴範禪師語錄), Zhe'an Jingfan says that enumerated explanations only make a board-carrying fellow (擔板漢) and asks how the matter can be raised whole.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若是擔板漢。多向句中死却。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Blue Cliff Record of Yuanwu Foguo (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄), Yuanwu Keqin says that a board-carrying fellow (擔板漢) often dies in the phrase.
